sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: US death row inmate Christa Pike is unconscious and on a ventilator following a failed execution attempt. Her lawyers filed an emergency motion to preserve evidence, alleging prison officials botched the lethal injection. They state officials used at least seven needles, bending one, while Pike whimpered and cried.
